fix.notes: The oracle.get_printing call requires a live database; in production the bot always has DB access. The check is short-circuited when preferred_printing is falsy (normal card lookups) so there is zero overhead for the common case.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

When a user typed `!art into the roil | THB`, the bot would silently return the default art for "Into the Roil" (from whichever set Scryfall picks) rather than telling the user the card wasn't in THB. This happened because `image_fetcher.scryfall_image()` already falls back to the default art when `oracle.get_printing()` returns `None` for the requested set — the art command never validated whether the set actually contained the card.

## What changed

In `discordbot/commands/art.py`, before deferring and fetching the image, we now check: if a `preferred_printing` (set code) was specified but no `preferred_printing_system_id` (exact Scryfall ID) was resolved, call `oracle.get_printing()` to confirm the card exists in that set. If not, send `"<card name> was not in <SET>."` and return early. The `preferred_printing_system_id` guard ensures we don't block the lookup when an exact alternate-name printing has already been resolved.

The existing test in `network_io_test.py` was updated to add a `.get()` method to the `SimpleNamespace` card mock (matching how `Card`, a `Munch`/dict subclass, behaves).

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit discordbot` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (functional tests pre-marked as skipped upstream)

Fixes #8451

evidence.detail: Art command downloads image without checking if preferred_printing was found; no guard for the case where the card was not in the requested set
scryfall_image() silently falls back to name-only URL (no set) when oracle.get_printing(c, preferred_printing) returns None
Flavor command correctly handles this: returns 'No flavor text for {c.preferred_printing}' when preferred_printing set but no matching printing found — the same pattern is needed in art.py
